title: One-shot and Signal-waiting Agent Discovery Spiral
objective: Run source-bound, read-only frontend and backend audits of the current ADL candidate for the proposed one-shot and signal-waiting agent lifecycles; synthesize a safe, market-relevant implementation contract while keeping execution fail-closed until source, authorization, idempotency, lifecycle and receipt decisions are concrete.

work_items.title: Bind the candidate and known lifecycle decision
deliverables: Candidate-bound scope and invariants for the frontend/backend audit spiral
done_when: Record existing dirty state is preserved
Carry forward one-shot/signal proposal and capability-manager fail-closed boundary
Assign only read-only audit work to the first safe batch

work_items.title: Audit frontend lifecycle, chat and review surfaces
deliverables: Frontend state map for creating one-shot and signal-waiting agent definitions
done_when: Trace current agent create/review/save and chat navigation
Map suitable lifecycle status, trigger configuration, waiting/paused/error/cancelled/completed states
Identify UI/test seams and avoid claiming an implemented trigger
Cite current source paths and line ranges; make no product edits

work_items.title: Audit backend lifecycle, trigger, execution and evidence seams
deliverables: Backend state and authority map for bounded one-shot execution and explicit-signal activation
done_when: Trace actual create, persistence, trigger ingestion, authorization/permit, execution gateway, cancellation and receipt seams
Separate implemented, disconnected, fixture and proposed paths
Identify idempotency/retry/lifetime and actor identity requirements
Cite current source paths and line ranges; make no product edits

work_items.title: Synthesize a project-adapted lifecycle contract and next implementation step
deliverables: Reviewable lifecycle contract, explicit open decisions and bounded next implementation packet
done_when: Define one-shot and signal-waiting states without conflating them with execution authority
Recommend a minimal signal source only if existing project seams support it
Specify owner/actor, expiry, idempotency, retry, cancellation, audit and trace requirements
Give a source-bound next frontend/backend batch with acceptance and validation
Keep unresolved consequential choices PROPOSED and preserve fail-closed Run
